Name: Ageing Machine (Automate Compatible)
Author: LW1743
Description:
Important!
I remade the mod in Content Patcher to lower to amount of required dependencies. Thus by updating the mod all current machines will despawn. The crafting recipe has also been updated.



The "Ageing Machine" is based on a scientific paper I recently read. The paper was about a method on ageing wine in minutes. Thus I created the ageing machine for Stardew Valley. The "Ageing Machine" can turn Wine, Beer, Mead and Pale Ale into gold quality withing 3 ingame hours. 

If you choose the easy version the Ageing Machine will be unlocked at Farming lvl 8.

If you choose the hard version you need to get 8 hearts with Demetrius and follow the quest line.

Study:
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.foodchem.2004.07.027

YouTube video about it:
https://youtu.be/YlQT4ptwLKs?

The following other mods are required:
- Content Patcher
- SMAPI
